meta.title: JEV tiered harness
meta.description: Adds a left-sidebar workbench and a composer switch that decide who does the work: OFF steps aside and uses the DSH model gateway, ON sends every instruction to a JEV judge first, which routes judgment tasks to Kimi K3.1Pro and execution tasks to DeepSeek4.1Flash101 through OpenAI-compatible gateways. No tier choice is exposed to the user. Tools: harness_call, harness_classify, harness_review, harness_probe. Fill each gateway's base URL, API key and exact model id in the sidebar page; JEV_API_KEY/KIMI_API_KEY/DSF_API_KEY work as an environment fallback.

jev.page.title: JEV tiered harness
jev.page.subtitle: Decision/quality tasks to Kimi, routine execution to DeepSeek Flash. Fill each gateway's address, key and real model id here.
